attchmntText: BLS Polymers Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: BLS Polymers Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 19, 2026. For Q2 FY27, consolidated revenues from operations stood at Rs. 125.56 crores, showing year-on-year growth of 28.92%. For H1 FY27, revenue increased by 35.63% to Rs. 232.59 crores. EBITDA grew by 41.47% to Rs. 33.57 crores, and PAT increased by 51% to Rs. 20.77 crores. The company currently operates a manufacturing capacity of 44,340 metric tons. It is executing an expansion plan to add 87,301 metric tons in the coming years. Management expects capacity to reach close to 55,000 tons by the end of FY27. Average EBITDA margin is projected at 13.25% with PAT margins of 7.5% to 8%. The company plans to reduce its trading revenue share and focus on manufacturing growth.

attchmntText: BLS Polymers Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: BLS Polymers Limited has made available the audio recording of the earnings conference call for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The call was held on Thursday, November 19, 2026, at 12:00 Noon IST. The audio file is accessible on the company website at the provided link. This filing is pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The intimation follows the previous notice dated November 16, 2026. The document was signed by Karan Chhabra, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, in Delhi.

attchmntText: BLS Polymers Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: BLS Polymers Limited has published its Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended on September 30, 2026. The advertisement was published on November 19, 2026, in the Financial Express and Jansatta newspapers. The clippings are available on the company website. Separately, L&T Infra Investment Partners Advisory Private Limited has extended the deadline for submission of Expression of Interest for bidding on Alternative Investment Fund units. The new deadline is November 27, 2026, by 6:00 p.m. The fund has 3,15,08,573 outstanding units with a principal investment amount of 1359.83 crore rupees. Bids are for the acquisition of at least 25 percent of the outstanding units.

attchmntText: BLS Polymers Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: BLS Polymers Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Revenue from operations increased by 28.92% year on year to 125.56 crore in the second quarter. EBITDA rose by 92.98% to 17.31 crore. Profit after tax grew by 130.63% to 10.54 crore. For the half year, revenue increased by 35.63% to 232.59 crore. EBITDA grew by 41.71% to 33.57 crore. Profit after tax increased by 51.16% to 20.77 crore. The company reported a share price of 281.00 as of 18 November 2026. Market capitalization stood at 1,743.09 crore. The presentation details the company's polymer compounding business and financial performance.

attchmntText: BLS Polymers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 18, 2026, titled "Press Release for the Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended on 30th September 2026".
voiceSummary: BLS Polymers Limited filed its unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. For Q2 FY27, operating revenue grew 28.92% year-on-year to ₹125.56 crore. EBITDA rose 92.98% to ₹17.31 crore. Profit after tax increased 130.63% to ₹10.54 crore. For H1 FY27, operating revenue increased 35.63% to ₹232.59 crore. EBITDA grew 41.71% to ₹33.57 crore. Profit after tax rose 51.16% to ₹20.77 crore. Earnings per share improved to ₹4.62 from ₹3.04. The company announced a proposed capacity expansion to enhance production capabilities. The press release was issued on 18 November 2026.

attchmntText: BLS Polymers Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: BLS Polymers Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board meeting was held on 18th November 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter was 12,556.29 Lakhs. Profit after tax for the quarter was 1,054.06 Lakhs. Earnings per share was 2.34. For the half year, revenue was 23,258.84 Lakhs. Profit after tax was 2,077.04 Lakhs. Earnings per share was 4.62. The company completed an Initial Public Offering of 1,70,00,000 equity shares at Rs. 150 per share. The shares were listed on NSE and BSE on 3rd November 2026. The results are subject to limited review by statutory auditors.
